why: Keyword scoring was replaced by per-run adjudicated labels. The regexes disagreed with the prose that cited them: a fixture argued one run counted because it says 'It hasn't been tested against 16', while the pattern missed that phrasing and reached the same total by counting a different run. The cohorts here were also wrong - the pre-fix composed arm omitted one of the four stacks that belonged in it. Both problems were found by cross-review. The runs this file scored are void anyway: they were recorded above Claude Code's hook context limit and never reached the model. See evals/composition/03.
